title: Frontend operational states, feedback components and accessibility affordances remain incomplete

original_titles.title: Admin FE hard rules unmet: prod banner, sensitive border, refresh cadence, pagination
No toast, no blocking modal, escalation at 10/2 min instead of 5/3/1, dead OfflineBanner, no catalog keys
No Modal, ConfirmModal or Toast components (C-07/C-08/C-09)
Event components missing/partial: no ProgressBar, no LevelCard/GateButton, countdown lacks onZero refetch and uses 2-min warning
No ConnectionIndicator or sync StatusChip in workspace header (C-28/C-29)
Participant page set incomplete: consent gate, activation/reset, dashboard elements, event details, team, system check, announcements, support, system pages
No copy catalog: all user-facing strings hard-coded inline
UI strings not externalized to message catalogs
No degraded/polling-fallback or kill-switch banner; polling is the only mode
No dedicated FAQ page/route; required topics (supported browsers, connection drop, workspace usage) missing
Status page missing entirely (no external host, component status, incidents, or maintenance)
Design token names deviate from spec set; fonts are static weights, not a variable font
Component-level deviations: Button lacks secondary/loading; ConfirmButton not typed-phrase; Countdown lacks role=timer and 10/5/1-min thresholds; StatusChip has no icon
Workspace and leaderboard polish gaps (grouped S3)
Countdown lacks role=timer and 5/1-minute announcements (CMP-09)
Client rewrites catalog error wording (ERC-03 S2-part)
Deadline UX lacks 'Time is up' banner and final summary (WS-11a S1-part)
Login screen lacks show/hide toggle, routed account states, Turnstile (ATH-01b S3)
Connection states and degraded banner not wired (CMP-14 S2, STP-04, WS-01d)
LB-03 workspace tour missing
Section 7 testing program essentially absent (no Vitest/RTL/Playwright/axe/MSW)
No copy catalog; all user-facing strings hardcoded inline
Error envelope lacks a 'Copy details' action
Leaderboard does not pin own team row; score card has no animation or live-region announce (C-24, C-25)
EXTRA/deviations worth recording: localStorage challenge-id memory, self-hosted fonts, inline confirm/receipt substitutions

problem: Some originally missing surfaces now exist: ProgressBar, LevelCard/Gate/GateButton, ConfirmModal, UploadDialog and 5/3/1-minute warnings. Remaining gaps include a reusable Toast/copy catalog, connection/degraded state, status/FAQ pages, some component keyboard/live-region details, event-page document titles/focus behavior, own-row leaderboard emphasis and a full production/sensitive-data admin banner.
impact: Users can complete the core four-level flow, but network degradation, errors, accessibility state and operator context are not consistently communicated. The original “no modal/no progress UI” claim is stale; the remaining issue is incomplete integration and polish.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Inventory the remaining required states per route: offline, reconnecting, sync pending, save failed, session expired, maintenance, read-only and service degraded. Assign each a shared component and source of truth.
Wire OfflineBanner/ConnectionIndicator to actual navigator state and API failures; distinguish “saved locally” from “saved on server”.
Add reusable Toast/notification and copy-details controls with request id, error code and a non-sensitive diagnostics payload.
Add keyboard/ARIA refinements: countdown role=timer, focus-to-heading after route navigation, keyboard-operable tabs/tree and live announcements for saved/submitted/score changes.
Add page titles, own-team row pinning and clear loading/empty/error states. Add FAQ/status page only if the owner confirms they are required for this event.

acceptance_criteria: Core status changes are announced to assistive technology.
Offline and degraded states are real, not decorative banners.
Required pages/components have keyboard and screen-reader regression tests.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.

residual_risk_or_scope_note: Modal/focus trap and deadline warning gaps are partly fixed; do not reopen the old claim that these components are wholly absent.
